checkpoint.initialization: Both arms strictly load the same source-qualified native E104 G, copy the same seeded stream branch with zero output head, and update all 328870 G parameters, original E104/default head frozen, reset AdamW.

sources.role: Same raw observation contract and pretarget source-qualified initialization. Recursively verify formal archival parent.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: The native parent passed a declared source rule before deployment. Target results never select fitting, hyperparameters, thresholds or retry.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze both at 18000. Only stream_context_native may qualify. Six exceeds chirp_context_native, the original native parent, archived W24 and other fixed comparators. Low urban exceeds matched chirp-only and is at least the other controls. Clean is at least direct and raw parent. Same 300 source V.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 [6,5,7,2,0], one new worker per card; actual free >=12 GiB and <8 resident CUDA contexts. At most two fit or formal workers. Preserve other owners.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent work on mismatched source contract/weight, lacking a finite L_s, accepted clean U_s or new output-head E104 gradient in the genuine source smoke, any nonfinite loss or invalid freeze. No target if source gate fails.

notes: Only physical continuity of the 1 MS/s complex capture during the added stack of convolutions changes.

Both use the same original U-Net time/spectrum, a 4-channel complex observation/correction input, 48 real features and depthwise + pointwise residual stages at dilations 1, 4, 16, 64, 256. Maximum receptive field is 1375 samples, with zeros at the actual recording boundaries.
The added complex correction is bounded to 0.25 times observed packet RMS for every sample, and exactly zero at initialization. No classification, target statistic or latent truth at inference.
Matched source pairs, frozen E104 supervised and pseudo CE, raw time/spectral loss, clean KL and identity.

The fixed reference is exactly the registered native source-qualified parent and archived Full route. A conditioned source gate uses all seven predictions frozen before scoring on the same 300 physical packets. If it passes, the run automatically continues to independent Full truth-last scoring.
